meta.title: Washington County — the money trail
meta.note: This is the county's 2026 budget, adopted by Ordinance 2025-074 and filed with the state. Amounts are the "2026 Requested" column of the budget the ordinance adopts. Some money is counted twice: the Child Support and Adult Drug Court funds move $34,500 to other funds, and the $10,197,472 Employee Insurance Fund is paid from department budgets that already include health insurance.
